Information received since the February meeting indicates continued labor-market strengthening and moderate growth; consistent with expectations-augmented Phillips-curve and New Keynesian models with sticky prices, inflation edging toward the symmetric 2 percent objective and anchored expectations justify gradual normalization, while low market-based inflation compensation and real-time slack mismeasurement risks (as emphasized by Orphanides) warrant a cautious, rule-informed approach (e.g., Taylor/McCallum). Overall tone: modestly positive but measured.
